summary: Frontend-only verification of Navbar admin-link removal on both desktop and mobile viewports after admin login. All 4 requested test cases PASSED. No 'Admin Panel' link exists anywhere in the public navbar (desktop or mobile). Regression checks for logged-out mobile menu and /admin direct access also pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navbar.js is clean - no 'admin' references. localStorage token key is 'nexora_token'. Desktop header for logged-in admin shows only user name 'Admin' + logout icon (data-testid nav-user-name, nav-logout-btn). Mobile menu (data-testid nav-mobile-menu) opened via nav-mobile-toggle shows nav links + 'Logout (Admin)' button. Logged-out mobile menu shows Login+Register, no Feedback (authOnly), no Admin. /admin route remains accessible directly for logged-in admin.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous iteration_2 flagged that mobile menu still had an Admin Panel link (lines 95-97). Fix now renders only the Logout button for logged-in users in mobile menu (Navbar.js line 93-94). Verified visually and via DOM text assertions.
